name: PM-KISAN (Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi)
summary: Income support scheme providing ₹6,000 per year to eligible small and marginal farmer families, paid in three equal instalments via Direct Benefit Transfer.
eligibility: Small and marginal farmer families with cultivable landholding, as per land records
Excludes institutional landholders, income-tax payers, current/former holders of constitutional posts, government employees above certain grades, and certain pensioners
Mandatory eKYC, Aadhaar-seeded bank account, and updated land records required to receive payments
fee: None — this is a benefit scheme, not a paid service
process: Register on the PM-KISAN portal or through the local Common Service Centre (CSC)/patwari/revenue officer
Submit Aadhaar, land records, and bank account details
State government verifies land records and eligibility
Approved beneficiaries receive ₹2,000 every 4 months directly in their bank account via DBT

faq.question: Why did I stop receiving instalments?
faq.answer: The most common reasons are incomplete eKYC, an Aadhaar-bank account mismatch, or land record verification pending with the state government. Check status on the beneficiary status page.

faq.question: How much does PM-KISAN pay and how often?
faq.answer: ₹6,000 per year, split into three instalments of ₹2,000 each, paid roughly every four months by Direct Benefit Transfer to the registered bank account.
